content:
name: Axon update
run-name: Axon update ${{ inputs.release }}
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release:
        required: true
        type: string
      expected_head:
        required: true
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: write
concurrency:
  group: axon-update
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Prepare release without changing the production branch
        env:
          RELEASE: ${{ inputs.release }}
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ inputs.expected_head }}
          DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          REPOSITORY_OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          OWNER_ID: ${{ github.repository_owner_id }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$RELEASE" =~ ^v(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ ]]
          [[ "$EXPECTED_HEAD" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]]
          [[ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" == "$DEFAULT_BRANCH" ]]
          git fetch origin "$DEFAULT_BRANCH"
          [[ "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" == "$EXPECTED_HEAD" ]]
          git fetch https://github.com/gokerlek/axon-fit.git "refs/tags/$RELEASE"
          release_commit=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
          manifest=$(git show "$release_commit:axon-release.json")
          jq -e --arg version "${RELEASE#v}" '.version == $version and .automaticUpdate == true and .dataMigration == false' <<< "$manifest"
          # Preserve workflow files: updates of these need a separately reviewed manual change.
          git read-tree "$release_commit"
          git rm -r -f --cached --ignore-unmatch .github/workflows
          if git cat-file -e "$EXPECTED_HEAD:.github/workflows" 2>/dev/null; then
            git restore --source="$EXPECTED_HEAD" --staged .github/workflows
          fi
          tree=$(git write-tree)
          git config user.name "$REPOSITORY_OWNER"
          git config user.email "$OWNER_ID+$REPOSITORY_OWNER@users.noreply.github.com"
          commit=$(printf 'Axon update %s' "$RELEASE" | git commit-tree "$tree" -p "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          git push origin "$commit:refs/heads/axon-update-$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
          printf 'Prepared %s. Publish from the PT settings screen.\n' "$RELEASE" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
